name: @openshapeforge/auth
//exports: Source-first, with a compiled fallback for bundlers.
This package's relative imports carry NodeNext `.js` specifiers, which
TypeScript (any moduleResolution) and Bun both map back onto the `.ts`
files. Bundlers do not: Turbopack resolves `./claims.js` literally and
fails. So Bun and TypeScript read `src/` — no build step, unchanged
behaviour for apps/api and the scripts — while anything else, notably
the Next build in apps/web, gets `dist/`. Consumers of `dist/` must
build it first; apps/web's own dev/build scripts do.
